messages:
Noah (CSM): heads-up — SmallCarrier Co. renewal in 28 days, health dropped to amber->red. Active seats down ~58% last 14d, one power-user resigned last week.
alert-bot: [ALERT] account=smallcarrier drop=58% period=14d renew=2026-04-18 health=RED
Rina (CS Ops): pulling the top features by DAU now. will also check recent webhook failures and login_errors metric.
Sam (Onboarding): they never finished the SSO checklist; ticket #567 still open. Also no post-trial adoption plan was sent.
Noah (CSM): root cause: staff churn + onboarding gap. quick micro-play: 1) 30-45m "restart" workshop with an engineer + ops; 2) in-app walkthrough nudges for 3 core flows; 3) 4 hours of free office hours + 500 credits tied to a small milestone; 4) fallback: offer a temporary Lite tier (fewer seats, prorated) with guaranteed data export and a re-onboard in 30d.
Jon (AM): ok to offer credits. prefer milestone = restore 25% of active seats in 30d. if not met, allow downgrade with option to re-upgrade at same price within 90d.
Rina (CS Ops): quick SQL I run: ```sql
SELECT feature, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
FROM events
WHERE account_id='smallcarrier' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY feature
ORDER BY active_users DESC;
```
Posting a two-row summary in 15m.
Sam (Onboarding): draft outreach: "Hey Alex — noticed activity slipped after your power user left. Can we run a 30m restart to finish SSO and trial three ready-made flows? Tue 3pm or Thu 11am? We'll bring an engineer and pre-filled prompts."
Noah (CSM): shorten and send after Rina posts numbers. Assignments: Sam = schedule + customer note; Rina = metrics + quick triage checklist; Jon = commercial offer draft; Noah = lead call and update renewal task.
Rina (CS Ops): triage checklist: SSO config, last 30d webhook 4xx/5xx rates, auth token expirations, integration errors > 5% escalate to eng-oncall.
Noah (CSM): downgrade-lite sketch (last resort): a) prorated Lite seat bundle for 3 months with data export & export assist; b) model tier locked to Standard; c) complimentary 2 re-onboard hours within 60d; d) if customer hits milestone within 60d offer a 25% re-upgrade credit.
Jon (AM): I'll post the credit number and conditional language by EOD.
Noah (CSM): next steps: Rina to post the usage table, Sam to confirm timeslot, Jon to post offer. We'll reconvene here after the restart session. Thanks all :thumbsup:
